youtube_full.title: The Valley That Woke Up | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Ezekiel 37:1–10
youtube_full.description:
The Valley That Woke Up: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Ezekiel 37:1–10.

In a vision, Ezekiel stood in a quiet valley. It was full of very old, dry bones.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Beau the Brave.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: The Valley That Woke Up
1:14 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Beau the Brave
1:52 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
3:04 Question time
3:22 Sweet dreams
3:39 More stories, the app and the paperback
